findings.claim: The workflow has a 360-minute job timeout. The invoked verifier applies 600 seconds to each Lean subprocess. Neither the verifier nor its resource observer implements an earlier overall wall-clock deadline.
evidence: workflow timeout-minutes and Check multiplicities step
findings.qualification: Observer proc.wait(timeout=30) follows the monitoring loop and is a shutdown grace period, not a total runtime budget.

findings.claim: After each successful compilation and profile/source validation, finalize_outputs promotes the output and the verifier writes a FRESH_KERNEL_EXPORT JSON record immediately. It then flushes PASS and COMPLETED_MODULE_JSON lines.
findings.qualification: These are local per-module completed checkpoints. There is no periodic remote artifact upload while the Lean step is running.

findings.claim: On a normal module timeout or compiler failure, the current pending outputs are removed and the verifier raises. Already completed object/record files are not removed by this path.

The next retention step and upload step both use if: always(). The retention step reads existing records, writes diagnostics_records.json, copies available FRESH_KERNEL_EXPORT objects and records, copies module logs, and copies receipt.json only if it exists.
evidence: workflow Retain completed records and diagnostics

findings.claim: The verifier writes the scope receipt only after every required source module has completed. Per-module progress is not a complete-scope receipt.
The resource observer flushes measurements to stderr approximately every 10 seconds and writes resource_observer.json after its process-monitoring loop ends.
The local sources do not guarantee execution or completion of post-job retention/upload after a hard platform job-timeout termination.
evidence: workflow always steps and job timeout
findings.qualification: An eventual terminal status, logs, artifact catalog and actual archive bytes must determine what was preserved. Wall-clock passage alone establishes neither a successful nor a failed kernel result.
